regions.readview: Proposition 3.1 (Well-posedness and stationarity of the conditional phase space process) . For every fixed y,\widetilde{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} and initial phase space point (x_{0},p_{0}), the event-driven dynamics in Algorithm 1 , with the reference point fixed at \widetilde{x}, defines a unique non-explosive, time-homogeneous Markov process. The phase space measure \nu_{\eta,y} is stationary for this process. In particular, the returned position x_{\pi} is well-defined almost surely.

regions.readview: Fix y,\widetilde{x}\in\mathbb{R}^{d}. In the notation of ( 3.4 ), the bounce rate ( 3.9 ) reads \lambda_{\widetilde{x}}(x,p)=\sqrt{\eta}\,[p^{\top}h_{\widetilde{x}}(x)]_{+}\,. The deterministic harmonic flow, namely the solution ( 4.5 ) of ( 3.8 ), and the bounce map are \displaystyle\Phi_{t}^{y,\widetilde{x}}(x,p) \displaystyle\coloneqq\bigl(c_{y,\widetilde{x}}+(x-c_{y,\widetilde{x}})\cos t+\sqrt{\eta}\,p\sin t,\;-\eta^{-1/2}(x-c_{y,\widetilde{x}})\sin t+p\cos t\bigr)\,, \displaystyle\mathsf{S}_{\widetilde{x}}(x,p) \displaystyle\coloneqq(x,R_{h_{\widetilde{x}}(x)}p)\,,\hskip 20.00003ptR_{0}\coloneqq I\,. The bounce map is an involution. Although there is a possible discontinuity at h_{\widetilde{x}}(x)=0, this creates no ambiguity because the event rate vanishes there.

regions.readview: To prove non-explosion, define the shifted harmonic energy H_{y,\widetilde{x}}(x,p)\coloneqq\frac{1}{2}\,\bigl\{\eta^{-1}\,\|x-c_{y,\widetilde{x}}\|^{2}+\|p\|^{2}\bigr\}\,. The flow and each bounce preserve this energy. Hence, with \mathcal{E}\coloneqq H_{y,\widetilde{x}}(x_{0},p_{0}), every state produced by the recursion satisfies \|p\|\leq\sqrt{2\mathcal{E}}\,,\hskip 20.00003pt\|x-c_{y,\widetilde{x}}\|\leq\sqrt{2\eta\mathcal{E}}\,. Because \nabla V is \beta-Lipschitz, \lambda_{\widetilde{x}}(x,p)\leq\bar{\lambda}_{\mathcal{E}}(y,\widetilde{x}) throughout the path, where \bar{\lambda}_{\mathcal{E}}(y,\widetilde{x})\coloneqq\sqrt{\eta}\,\beta\sqrt{2\mathcal{E}}\,\bigl\{\sqrt{2\eta\mathcal{E}}+\|c_{y,\widetilde{x}}-\widetilde{x}\|\bigr\}\,. Hence, \int_{0}^{u}\lambda_{\widetilde{x}}(\Phi_{s}^{y,\widetilde{x}}(\zeta_{T_{n}}))\,\mathrm{d}s\leq\bar{\lambda}_{\mathcal{E}}(y,\widetilde{x})\,u\,. If \bar{\lambda}_{\mathcal{E}}(y,\widetilde{x})=0, the event rate vanishes and there are no jumps. Otherwise, ( A.1 ) implies, for every finite waiting time, S_{n+1}\geq\frac{E_{n+1}}{\bar{\lambda}_{\mathcal{E}}(y,\widetilde{x})}\,. If the recursion does not terminate, it follows that T_{n}\geq\frac{\sum_{j=1}^{n}E_{j}}{\bar{\lambda}_{\mathcal{E}}(y,\widetilde{x})}\longrightarrow\infty almost surely by the strong law of large numbers. Thus, the jump times cannot accumulate, and the recursive construction defines a unique process for all t\geq 0. Finally, the memoryless property of the exponential clocks gives the time-homogeneous Markov property. This is precisely the integrated hazard construction of Davis [ 12 , Section 2] . ∎
